market_definition: The Mozambique Fire Insurance Market encompasses insurance policies designed to provide financial protection against physical loss or damage to buildings, properties, machinery, equipment, inventories, and other insured assets caused by fire and associated risks, including lightning and explosions. The market covers basic standalone fire insurance, extended standalone fire insurance, and property multi-risk insurance policies incorporating fire coverage. It includes residential, commercial, industrial, agricultural, institutional, infrastructure, and mixed-use properties insured by individuals, businesses, government entities, and other organizations across Mozambique. KEY INCLUSIONS: standalone fire insurance (basic and extended policies covering fire, lightning, explosions and other associated perils); property multi-risk insurance (residential, commercial and industrial policies incorporating fire protection); insured buildings and physical assets (residential buildings, commercial establishments, industrial facilities, warehouses, machinery, equipment, furniture, inventories); all policyholder categories (individuals and households, micro to large businesses, state-owned enterprises, government institutions, non-profit organizations); all property uses and end-user sectors (residential, agricultural, manufacturing, mining, oil and gas, energy, utilities, transportation, hospitality, healthcare, education, retail and others); fire-related additional coverage (smoke damage, firefighting damage, debris removal, fire-related business interruption); all specified distribution channels (insurer direct, insurance brokers, agents, bancassurance, affinity partnerships, institutional partnerships). KEY EXCLUSIONS: non-fire property insurance (standalone theft, burglary, flood, earthquake or storm policies without fire cover); other insurance categories (life, health, motor, marine, aviation, personal accident, workers' compensation, standalone liability); motor and cargo fire coverage provided only under motor, marine cargo or goods-in-transit policies; standalone business interruption insurance; specialized agricultural and engineering insurance (crop, livestock, construction all-risk, machinery breakdown) outside the fire / property scope; uninsured properties and losses; reinsurance and ancillary services (reinsurance transactions, fire prevention equipment, firefighting services, insurance consulting and other non-insurance activities); insurance outside Mozambique. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - FIRE / PROPERTY INSURANCE SELLER: a company headquartered in Mozambique that underwrites, sells or places fire or property multi-risk insurance - licensed insurers (insurer direct) and the insurance brokers, agents and similar intermediaries named in the distribution channels. EXCLUDED companies: reinsurers; insurance consultants, loss adjusters and surveyors; fire-prevention equipment and firefighting firms; companies selling only motor, life, health, marine, aviation, liability, crop or engineering insurance; non-insurance businesses; companies headquartered outside Mozambique.
who_is_included: SERVICE PROVIDER DEFINITION (services market): a company that PERFORMS this service commercially for third-party customers - it is contracted to do the work, or sells the course, inspection, survey or certification as its own offering. Operators, contractors, consultancies, accredited training organisations and certification bodies all qualify when this work is what customers pay them for. EXCLUDED: manufacturers whose only service is support or familiarisation for their own products; equipment sellers with no service delivery; marketplaces and directories that merely list providers. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
